content.body: Paratroopers were elite troops well armed for the assault role they were frequently dropped into, and their tough training gave them extra stamina over their regular infantry counterparts.
content.brief: WEAPON: Maschinenpistole 38/40 (MP40) AMMO: 9 mm Parabellum MAGAZINE: 32 round clip MUZZLE VELOCITY: 390 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 400-500 rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: Luger Pistole 08 9 mm Automatic StiG 24 HE Grenades (4) NbHgn 39 Smoke Grenades (4) Satchel Charge (1) Combat Knife
content.title: Fallschirmjäger (Paratrooper)
